objective: Test whether candidate MK_FUTURE representations safely quotient a frozen small reachable CNF state universe by exact correctness-relevant future semantics.

critical_distinction.MK_ID: Exact canonical-state identity for audit/replay; equal MK_ID implies identical canonical CNF state.
critical_distinction.MK_FUTURE: Future-semantic interface; equal keys may intentionally merge different exact states only when every authorized continuation has the same correctness-relevant result.

future_equivalence.terminal_observation: Boolean truth after any total continuation; actions on semantically irrelevant variables are identity at the quotient level.
future_equivalence.exact_characterization_in_R0: Future equivalence is exact equality of the Boolean function over the fixed global variable universe {1,2,3,4}. A differing row yields an explicit distinguishing ASSIGN continuation.
future_equivalence.certified_merge_candidate: S1!=S2 AND K(S1)=K(S2) AND S1 ≡_J S2

frozen_universe.base_clause_pool: all non-tautological clauses over variables 1..4 of width 1..3 with no repeated variable
base_cnfs: all unique canonical CNFs with 1 or 2 clauses from the pool
plus 2048 deterministic three-clause CNFs selected by SHA256(namespace||clause_indices) order
frozen_universe.reachable_closure: close the frozen base CNFs under every total ASSIGN and EXISTS transition over variables 1..4 until no new canonical CNF state appears
canonicalization: represent FALSE as CNF containing empty clause

MK_FUTURE_STRUCT_V0.role: lossy candidate expected to face counterexamples

MK_FUTURE_TRUTH_V0.role: exact semantic oracle/control, not a polynomial-size claim
MK_FUTURE_TRUTH_V0.payload: fixed global variable universe + full 16-bit truth-table vector

MK_FUTURE_ROBDD_V0.role: exact canonical representation candidate under one frozen variable order
MK_FUTURE_ROBDD_V0.payload: canonical reduced ordered binary decision DAG for the Boolean function over fixed order [1,2,3,4]; semantically irrelevant variables reduce away
MK_FUTURE_ROBDD_V0.warning: finite exactness does not establish polynomial worst-case BDD size

gates.G1_MK_ID_EXACT: zero collisions among distinct canonical states
gates.G2_STRUCTURAL_MONSTER_EXISTS: at least one MK_FUTURE_STRUCT_V0 semantic collision with explicit distinguishing continuation
gates.G5_ROBDD_NONTRIVIAL_MERGE: at least one pair of distinct canonical CNFs with equal ROBDD key and exact future equivalence
gates.G6_TRANSITION_CONGRUENCE: for every reachable state and every total ASSIGN/EXISTS action over variables 1..4, direct ROBDD key of the exact CNF successor equals the ROBDD key obtained by semantic update U_a from the predecessor truth function
gates.G7_COST_ACCOUNTING: record state bytes, truth-interface bits, ROBDD nodes/bytes, discovery/update work proxies and collision-search work; no pointer/hash-only accounting
gates.G8_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY: finite survivor is never promoted to universal theorem; P_VS_NP remains OPEN

promotion_rule: R0 cannot emit FORMALLY_CERTIFIED; that verdict requires an independent symbolic proof of transition congruence and claimed-domain sufficiency beyond bounded enumeration.
journal_rule: Every failed key language stores the first exact collision monster and its distinguishing continuation. Every survivor stores all measured costs and explicit unresolved theorem obligations.

development_history.nonvoting_dry_run: A pre-freeze engineering dry-run used syntactic live-variable applicability inside K and exposed a transition-congruence mismatch: semantic function equality did not reconstruct syntactic variable disappearance after canonical simplification.
development_history.preserved_lesson: MK_FUTURE is intended to quotient correctness-relevant future semantics, not reconstruct the full CNF syntax. Final R0 therefore freezes a total semantic continuation algebra on a fixed variable universe; syntactically absent variables act as semantic identity.
